_comment: workflow-register (DR-1342): the total line count of .github/workflows may only go DOWN; re-freeze lower with `node scripts/workflow-register.mjs --generate`. To RAISE it, edit by hand with a one-line reason here.

raises.reason: A required guard step in ci.yml for subprocess-budget-guard: one `- run:` line, four comment lines and a blank separator. The guard must be in ci.yml and not only verify:gates, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) -- verify-covers-ci-guards.test.js fails the build without it. The original comment was 17 lines and was folded to four with the narrative in the record, so this is the irreducible cost of the step rather than its first draft.

One NEW workflow, lesson-mail-label.yml (114 lines), which gives the DR-0312 capture lock a road a runner can walk -- it had never been set on a single built thread because the only road stopped for a human approval on every call. The ceiling exists to refuse BLOAT, not to refuse capability; this is a whole new step of an existing Way, not a longer version of one. Its first draft was 119 lines and its header was folded to 17 with the narrative moved into the record and session note, so this is the step's cost and not its first draft. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

Nine lines in lesson-mail-label.yml so a DORMANT run that was asked to label threads exits 1 instead of 0: the error line naming the label, the thread count, where the secret comes from and that lesson-mail-watch.yml needs the same one, plus the comment recording that the first live dispatch went GREEN having laboured on nothing. The ceiling refuses bloat, not a safeguard being made able to fail loudly -- the alternative was a log line and a green run, which is what this corrects. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

source-transcript-nas.yml gains a more_video_ids input so a burst of links is one run instead of five dispatches that cancel each other (measured 2026-11-06: two of five cancelled by the concurrency group). One comment line and four input lines; the narrative is in the record.

loops-health.yml now READS the nas-heartbeat loop (its last-run.json in its own home, install path, cron prefix, a red on a ledger that says the row could not be written, and a dark-loop diagnosis line): the a-service-comes-home gate refused the services.json entry until the witness actually looked. Twelve lines, four of them the comment that names why the ledger exists; raised to the measured total, not above it.

A required guard step in ci.yml for forward-safe-gate-guard: one `- run:` line and two comment lines. It must be in ci.yml and not only verify:gates, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) and verify-covers-ci-guards.test.js fails the build without it. Three lines is the step's cost: the narrative lives in the record and the guard's own header, not in the YAML. First written as 22396 -> 22399 against the main of the hour; after merging main (ll284 and the proof-of-work record raised it to 22413) the same three lines are 22413 -> 22416, which is the measured total and not above it.

Every tailnet join in the repo now goes through .github/actions/join-tailnet, which VERIFIES the join by asking tailscale itself rather than trusting the step's conclusion (DR-1284). 68 join sites across 64 workflows passed secrets.TS_AUTHKEY directly, so one key failure shut 68 roads at once -- measured again on inbox-lessons-waiting run 42709659655, which failed at 'Verify the tailnet actually joined'. The growth is the door's input lines per site plus a sparse actions/checkout at the 21 sites that had none (a local composite action cannot be read without a checkout, measured before converting, which is the only reason those 21 did not break). The oauth-* inputs are DORMANT: DR-1360 withdrew the OAuth client as the fix and governs. First written as 22413 -> 22659 against the main of the hour; after merging main (DR-1363's three lines raised it to 22416) the same change is 22416 -> 22662, which is the measured total and not above it.

Two dormant lanes are given a voice. lesson-mail-watch.yml had 480 runs from 2026-08-25 to 2026-11-09, every sampled one an honest no-op exiting 0, so 77 days of a shut Gmail door were visible only in the raw log of run 480; the dormant branch now also emits a ::warning:: and a step summary naming what it costs and the one value that fixes it. nas-email-door.yml reports SMTP_APP_PASSWORD presence BEFORE its tailnet gate, because that fact does not depend on the tailnet and was unreachable behind a dead TS_AUTHKEY -- it decides whether a dark lane is a wiring fix or a value only Darrell can mint (DR-1159). The growth is almost entirely the comments that record the 480-run measurement and name this as the WEAK fix, with the rolling-issue ledger (DR-0125's shape) as the dated follow-up; raised to the measured total, not above it.

loops-health.yml gains its second road (DR-1360): the join carries continue-on-error, and one step reads the heartbeat the NAS writes itself over poetech.us/sb when the box could not be asked over SSH, writing the same witness the judge, report and incident steps already read. Three lines of comment, five of step, one flag, two small judge edits; the narrative is in the record. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

0319's smoke must be run by a leg (rls-isolation-matrix-guard refuses an orphan smoke) and proven on a bare Postgres in CI: a three-line leg in rls-isolation.yml and a two-line step in ci.yml's withdraw-walls job, folded to one run line with no comment, the narrative in the record. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

One NEW workflow, exposure-report.yml (58 lines): Darrell asked for workflows that keep us secure without undermining our processes, reporting the conditions before any fix, inside the app. It ranks every known vulnerability in what we ship by the four elements and publishes the report the Exposure strip reads; it is report only (no fix, no PR, no push), one run at a time, ten minutes at most. A whole new capability, not a longer version of one; its header carries the read-only promise the tests pin. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

ci.yml did not parse from 29dc042 on: a one-line `run:` held 'SMOKE: PASS', a colon and a space in a plain YAML value, so GitHub ran no ci.yml job on four pushes and nothing showed red. The step becomes a block (+2), and a new workflow, workflows-parse.yml (31 lines), parses every workflow on any change to them; it cannot live inside the file it guards, because a file that does not parse runs nothing. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

The NAS's two witnesses are gated. Neither infra/nas-loops/test_heartbeat.py nor the new test_lesson_queue_census.py was run by CI: both test files existed and nothing executed them, which is the brake-without-a-witness shape this repo keeps finding. One step now runs both, and the comment above it records WHY the census test matters most: it parses scripts/lesson-inbox-waiting.sql and fails if the loop's exclusion list drifts from the lane's, because a census taken on 2026-11-10 dropped not-a-lesson and withdrawn and so counted rows a person had taken back (DR-1142, DR-0725). Raised to the measured size, not above it.

loops-health.yml now READS the lesson-queue-census loop, exactly as it was made to read nas-heartbeat: its last-run.json in its own home, its install path, its `lesson-queue-census:` cron lines, a red when that ledger says the count could not be written, and a line in the dark-loop diagnosis. The a-service-comes-home gate caught the services.json entry with the loop on NEITHER list and failed the first push of PR #2604 by name -- doing its job -- and a name beside a witness that never looks at it is the hollow version of walking the Way, so the witness was made to look first. Sixteen lines, six of them the comment recording that this ledger carries counts and never a person's words. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

inbox-lessons-waiting.yml gains its second road (DR-1360/DR-1399's shape): the join carries continue-on-error, one step reads the lesson-queue census the NAS takes for itself over poetech.us/sb when the tailnet is shut, the run log reports WHICH road answered, and a closing step fails the job when NEITHER road read the queue. That last step is the reason this is not pure growth: making both read steps continue-on-error is exactly how a lane starts reporting success for work it did not do, so the brake had to ship with the capability. MEASURED cause: runs #500-#505 -- six consecutive firings of the PRIORITY lesson lane -- all died at the join on a key that expired 2026-11-04 and again by 11-10, while the queue sat on a machine that was up and the census that counts it had been running all along, unreadable from outside for the same reason. The ceiling refuses bloat, not a road that removes a single point of failure. First written at 22973; the three comment blocks were folded to 10, 11 and 8 lines (-21) with the narrative moved into the record, so this is the mechanism's cost and not its first draft. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

The PoeTech+ checkout. poetech-plus-keys.yml (80 lines) turns the one value only Darrell holds, his Stripe secret key, into the whole go-live DR-0263 left to his hand: it makes the $39/month Price (refusing any other amount), the webhook with its signing secret and the cancel portal, installs the Pages secrets, redeploys and proves the live site offers PoeTech+. A LIVE key is refused unless the dispatch types CHARGE-REAL-MONEY. ci.yml +4 runs the 0321 smoke (a member reads only their own row and cannot grant a tier) and rls-isolation.yml +3 adds it to the matrix. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

Bishop Gwin's messages become lessons from the NAS's side. ci.yml +1 runs test_bg_message_lessons (a message with no named speaker is never sent as his; a message is sent once); loops-health.yml +1 reads the new loop's own last-run.json in the diagnosis, beside its name in the loops list, install map, cron prefix and heartbeat receipt (edited on existing lines). Raised to the measured total, not above it.

poetech-plus-keys.yml runs daily as well as by hand (Darrell: should he have to do this later, or can it be automated for consistency). +19 lines: the schedule, and a gate step that makes a daily run do nothing when no key is set, nothing when the live site already offers PoeTech+, and never install a live key (that still needs a dispatch typing CHARGE-REAL-MONEY), with every later step gated on it. So the one paste of his key is the only hand ever needed, and a lost Pages environment heals itself. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

A required guard step in ci.yml for reviewer-lens-registry-guard: one `- run:` line and two comment lines. It must be in ci.yml and not only verify:gates, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) -- verify-covers-ci-guards.test.js fails the build without it. The comment was five lines in its first draft (the whole Darrell-read-the-banner narrative) and was folded to two, with the narrative kept in the guard's own header and the record. Raised to the measured total, not above it. Re-froze at 23062 after merging main (DR-1443's PR landed fewer YAML lines than it replaced), so the ceiling sits at the measured total, not at the raise. (This record briefly moved to 1445 and then 1446 while two sessions renumbered the same collision from opposite sides; #2631 landed first and vacated 1441 by moving sov74 to 1446, so the record is back on the number it merged with and the renumbers are reverted.)

A required guard step in ci.yml for re-review-ratchet-guard: one `- run:` line and two comment lines. It must be in ci.yml and not only verify:gates, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) -- verify-covers-ci-guards.test.js fails the build without it. The comment is two lines, the same shape as the reviewer-lens step beside it, with the narrative in the guard's own header and DR-1444. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

The institute-walls job in ci.yml and the institute-roll leg in rls-isolation.yml: 0325's ten-assertion smoke must run on a bare postgres:16 in CI and against the real database after db-migrate, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) and the matrix guard refuses an orphan smoke. Each comment folded to three lines, the walls named in the smoke's own header and DR-1460. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

The parallel-lesson pipeline: ci.yml's push filter skips reserve/** (a reservation is an empty commit on main and needs no CI run) and its guards leg runs unfilled-verse-token-guard, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3); keep-prs-current.yml gains one step that deletes the number reservations main has passed. One comment line per change, the narrative in DR-1468. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

live-homepage-still.yml, dispatch only: a runner's Chrome opens the production Love Corner door at a phone and a desktop width, waits for the door's own header (DR-1483) and leaves the stills as an artifact, because the sandbox has no route to poetech.us (DR-0125) and DR-0104 asks that the live push be reviewed on the live site. It calls the reusable _browser-probe.yml; the caller is the trigger, the brake and the arguments only. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

inbox-lessons-waiting.yml's rolling-log step gains one elif: when the tailnet is shut and the house's own census answered, its lines ride the log entry instead of only the count, because the shape and the stall reasons are what decide whether a waiting teaching is buildable at all and reaching them in the step summary costs a cloud session thousands of tokens (DR-1186). The comment is folded to five lines with the measurement in DR-1507 and its session note. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

live-kids-zone-walk.yml, dispatch only: a runner's Chrome opens the production door at a phone width and walks the Kids Zone v1 the way a child does (the home, the Theater, the games, a storybook page, the badges and the map, the Teens door, the church's Home tab), asserts what a user sees, proves the served build is the merged commit, and leaves the stills as an artifact, because the sandbox has no route to poetech.us (DR-0125) and DR-0104 asks that the launch be reviewed on the live site. It calls the reusable _browser-probe.yml; the caller is the trigger, the brake and the arguments only. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

voice-health.yml reads the public /voice/health on every run with no key (which engine answers, the tower's studio or the NAS's own clone, its reason and the speed the NAS measured), because the tailnet key the rest of the witness rides has been dead since 2026-11-04 (DR-1360); and its where-the-install-stands block gains the clone's running code, unit, /health and install log. ci.yml gains the clone's selftest step. The comment is folded to one line. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

church-site-probe.yml, dispatch only and read-only: a runner reads the church's public website (the sandbox has no route to it) and prints its pages, headings and any feed, so the announcements-and-events sync Darrell asked for the same day (DR-1540) is built on what the site actually publishes, not on a guess. permissions {} and a concurrency group; nothing is written anywhere. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

church-site-probe.yml gains a second read-only step: the home page named /calendar.html, /current-events.html and the letters pages (no feed, no API; a Weebly site), so the probe now prints those pages as text with their images, embeds and links. That is what the announcements-and-events sync (DR-1540) parses; it is read before it is built. Still permissions {}, one at a time, nothing written. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

church-site-probe.yml, third read-only step: prints the raw markup around the calendar image, the current-events heading, the letter image and the home service times, so the parser the app runs on those pages (DR-1540) is built and tested on the site's real markup, captured as fixtures. Still permissions {}, one at a time, nothing written. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

ci.yml surface-sweep leg gains one three-line step: the app journeys' third planted fault (--break=signin), which withholds the signed-in stand-in so the TLC Assistant never mounts and office-assistant-answers must fail (DR-0076 section 3: proven to catch). The journey itself was the dated deferral that turned the guards red on 2026-11-19. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

0339's smoke must be run by a leg (rls-isolation-matrix-guard refuses an orphan smoke): a three-line person-doors leg in rls-isolation.yml with no comment, the walls named in the smoke's own header and DR-1591. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

ci.yml gains the classify job (26 lines), two lines per skippable leg (needs + if, 14 legs) and seven aggregator lines, so a lesson-only push skips the 13 PostgreSQL wall legs, the door journeys and (unless it touches a course the probe opens) the layout probe: measured 24 jobs a lesson PR before. The ceiling refuses bloat; this is the lane's runner load going down by about 13 jobs a PR. The deploy fold in DR-1603 gives lines back. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

One NEW workflow, church-site-archive.yml (91 lines): the daily reader Darrell asked for so the church office never has to archive by hand. Its keep job reads the public church site with the app's own parser and keeps each new calendar, letter and flyer on the NAS over the tailnet road the deploy walks; its walls job proves migration 0342 on a bare PostgreSQL for a pull request touching it, so the smoke runs in CI without editing ci.yml while another session reworks the lane. Budget (timeouts, a picture cap) and a single-instance lock, per the three-brakes rule as amended. A new step of an existing Way, not a longer version of one. Plus six lines in rls-isolation.yml: one matrix leg naming the 0342 smoke, because the matrix guard holds that a smoke no leg runs proves nothing. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

Three lines, one per setup-java step in android-package.yml (2) and native-shell.yml (1): check-latest: true, so every run fetches the newest patched Temurin build of its major version instead of a runner-cached one (Java4Shell notice, 2026-11-23). Folded to one line each with the comment inline; the irreducible cost of the fix.

One new 34-line workflow, nas-funnel-report.yml: the receiver for the NAS's own Funnel report (repository_dispatch from funnel_watchdog.py), which puts the box's Tailscale state on the funnel-incident ledger; the only road that reads the box while the tailnet key is dead and the public Funnel is dark. Plus one ci.yml line running its 15 proven-to-catch tests, and one funnel-health.yml line so its witness asks the six rows the watchdog now restores.

learn-presentation-prepare.yml (59 lines, folded from 107; dispatch-only until the full library is approved; its narrative lives in docs/99-session-notes/2026-11-23-learn-presentation-redesign-phase-1-2.md): the only automated road that prepares a title and thumbnail for each newly published lesson, with the three brakes (one spend cap per run, a concurrency group, an OFF switch) and an integrity check before and after. +1 line reconciles main measuring 23478 against 23477 at fecaf8a.

learn-presentation-prepare.yml pilot-1 fix (+11 lines): compose, export, the closing integrity check, the cache save and the artifact upload became separate always() steps so a failure after paid generation never loses the titles, images or spend ledger (pilot 1 lost its export and closing check to one crash); a guard stops the run before any spend when no saved ledger is restored (no double spend, no regeneration). The owner asked for both.

kids-episode-narration.yml (36 lines): speaks a Bible Adventures episode script with the open Kokoro voice (Apache-2.0) on a runner, because the sandbox cannot reach Hugging Face; the Jonah episode's narration is timed from it. A new capability (the episode road DR-1527 named), not a longer version of one; one-shot on push, timeout and concurrency as its brakes. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

One new workflow, llm-road-probe.yml (65 lines as the register counts them), dispatch-only and read-only: Ari's road, /llm, is on neither the NAS watchdog's restore list nor the outside witness's list, the sandbox has no route to it, and the repository gives its server the port the installed Scribe service uses. The probe reads which Funnel mounts exist, which ports listen and which one answers /llm/health, so the port is measured before it is written into a script that rewrites the Funnel. A timeout and a concurrency group; nothing is restarted, written or mounted. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

One line in nas-funnel-report.yml: the receiver also prints the NAS's words to the job log, because a session with no route to the site and a dead tailnet key can read a job log and cannot read a run summary. The same change lets it open the incident for Ari's road (llm-dark) on an existing line. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

church-site-archive.yml gains three steps on the road it already walks (pull the archive's calendars and flyers not yet read, read each once, file what was read: 15 lines), a two-line brakes header (the narrative folded into the record), and the walls job proves 0343 and the reads tool's selftest (9 lines) so the smoke runs on a pull request touching it. Plus three lines in rls-isolation.yml: the 0343 smoke's matrix leg, because a smoke no leg runs proves nothing. A new step of an existing Way, not a longer version of one. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

One new required CI leg in ci.yml, nas-python38 (17 lines): it runs the NAS-side Python guard and the nas-loops tests inside python:3.8.15, the NAS's own interpreter, because every other leg runs 3.11+ and that is how datetime.UTC shipped and broke bg-message-lessons on the box every cycle. A timeout as its brake. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

This branch's Learn picture lanes, re-measured on main after the merge: learn-thumbs-pull wiring (ci.yml +1 test, loops-health.yml +8), learn-imagegen-tower.yml (+54: a read-only tower probe whose key-shape step names why a tailnet key is refused without printing it), and the learn-presentation-prepare storage-first gate (header folded, net 0). Previously recorded on the branch as 23649->23658->23708->23712; main moved under it, so one raise to the measured merged total, not above it.

One line in loops-health.yml: the church-archive rider's own state/church-archive.out read in the dark-loop diagnosis, the content-sync pattern, so the loop is witnessed before its services.json entry is allowed (a-service-comes-home). The same PR re-froze the ceiling 27 lines lower when the runner road was retired, so this sits well under where main stood. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

Three lines for the Cloudflare Tunnel road (DR-1653): one ledger read of cf-tunnel's own last-run.json in loops-health.yml, plus its where-the-install-stands diagnosis, so the new loop is witnessed before its services.json entry is allowed (a-service-comes-home); and VITE_SUPABASE_FALLBACK_URL in the deploy build env (with its two-line why), empty until the repo variable SB_TUNNEL_ORIGIN is set. Raised to the measured total, not above it.
